notes.title: New patch with new cards
notes.notes:
To thank all Draconian Wars players for their patience with those pesky bugs, today we're launching a new patch that fixes a number of bugs and includes seven new cards. These seven cards will be added to your game for free. The list of updates of the patch is as follows:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused challenges to crash randomly.
[*]Fixed a number of bugs that affected skirmishes against the AI.
[*]Seven new cards:
[list]
[*]Red Wing Corsair
[*]Navigator Emblem
[*]Rapid Deployment
[*]Cyclonic Storm
[*]Talisman Of Devotion
[*]Mark Of The Rider
[*]Experimental Pilot
[/list]
[*]Added a new skirmish that employs some new cards introduced in this patch.
[*]Fixed some typos in the English and Spanish versions of the game.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the strategical possibilities that these new cards bring to the table.

The Kardfy Team.

notes.title: New patch released
notes.notes:
And another patch has been uploaded with the following fixed issues: 
- Cards player owns are not showed on the shop anymore.
- New option to exclude foils on the shop. 
- Fixed a bug on the deck editor that showed wrong cost and fate distributions.
- Rewarded cards after completing a match are now properly saved.

notes.title: New patch released
notes.notes:
We uploaded a new patch with the following fixed issues: 
- Fixed a number of bugs on multiplayer that caused the game to freeze.
- Added option to change language to the settings menu. 
- Text of cards is now more readable even without zooming in. 
- Fixed other minor issues.

notes.title: New patch released
notes.notes:
We just uploaded a new patch with the following fixed issues:
- Card effects with randomness (for example, Cyrus McCormick's ability) could make the AI crash. This has been fixed.
- A Second Opportunity now works as intended.
- With certain resolutions, during the advanced tutorial some windows may block a card making it impossible to finish. Help windows have been moved so this doesn't happen.
- Completing the tutorials now unlocks the achievement.
- Minor language issues.
Your copy of the game should be updated soon.
